title: Indian-Style Chicken Stir Fry
description: A quick and flavorful stir fry made with chicken, British-style spices, and crispy vegetables. Perfect for a weeknight dinner.
instructions: Heat 1 tbsp of oil in a large pan over medium-high heat.
Add the chicken and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the curry powder and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the onion, bell pepper, and carrot. Cook until the vegetables are tender, about 5 minutes.
Stir in the remaining 1 tbsp of oil and cook for 1 minute.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh cilantro if desired.
